49	- `ARCH_HAVE_RESET=y` 已存在；`CONFIG_BOARDCTL_RESET` 当前未开；`board_reset()` 在 `vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52/sf32lb52_lchspi_ulp/src/sifli_ap.c:652`，打开宏即可用 `boardctl(BOARDIOC_RESET)`。

1	# 端侧健康监测、告警与自治恢复
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	当前设备端只有 `/api/health` 的 3 个字段（`uptime/free_heap/time_synced`），且 `ok` 硬编码为 `true`；真正的内存/任务/网络快照只存在于 LVGL 采样线程，未进 API。没有线程心跳、错误计数、reset reason 或持久化证据。`/dev/watchdog0` 驱动已注册但从未武装（默认约 2.5 s，会误杀 180 s 的 LLM 请求），主机 `pipeline_watchdog.sh` 只能看 HTTP 200 和音频字节，无法区分“降级但还活着”和“真挂死”。
6	
7	目标：在设备端建立统一的健康快照，用规则+趋势判断异常，上屏/上报/可被 Agent 查询，并在异常时先做服务级恢复、必要时受控软复位；只持久化极少量 boot/reset/anomaly 信息。**不修** `sem_waitirq.c:137` 内核竞态，**不启用**硬件看门狗，**不做**完整 LittleFS 健康历史。
8	
9	已核实的关键约束：
10	- `ARCH_HAVE_RESET=y` 已存在，打开 `CONFIG_BOARDCTL_RESET` 即可用 `boardctl(BOARDIOC_RESET)`；`board_reset()` 在 `sifli_ap.c:652`。
11	- RTC 备份寄存器 `HAL_Set_backup/Get_backup` 已实现；7=BT_TXPWR、8=NAND_OTA、9=MODULE_RECORD 为 SDK 保留，**使用 5/6**。
12	- `ws_server_start()` 会清空客户端表；WS 只能做 **listener-only 重启**，不能整服务重启。
13	- `mic_stream_start/stop` 已有，可安全重启；`agent_loop` 无停止接口，卡死只能软复位。
14	- `agent_task_create()` 已接收 name 但当前忽略，需要补 `pthread_setname_np()`。
15	- `HAL_PMU_CheckBootMode()` 当前无调用点，可在 `board_late_initialize()` 一次性捕获 reset reason。
16	
17	---
18	
19	## 总体架构
20	
21	```
22	各服务计数器/心跳 ──> health_monitor（独立线程，5 s）
23	                        ├─ 规则/趋势/状态机
24	                        ├─ health_snapshot（mutex + seq）
25	                        ├─ 恢复状态机（mic 重启 / WS listener 重启 / 软复位）
26	                        └─ health_store（RTC BKP5/BKP6，boot/reset/anomaly）
27	                              ↓
28	        /api/health、WS health、屏幕状态页、get_health 工具、主机 watchdog
29	```
30	
31	设计原则：
32	- health 线程独立于 LVGL；UI 采样线程退化为快照消费者。
33	- 计数器用 32 位原子加；快照发布用 mutex + seq，格式化在锁外。
34	- 恢复动作只在 health 线程执行；HTTP/Agent 只设置请求标志，避免多线程操作服务。
35	- 所有阈值放 Kconfig，HIL 可调；默认按当前 ~8.6 MB heap 设计。
36	
37	---
38	
39	## 实施阶段
40	
41	### Phase 0 — 计数器与快照骨架（不改行为）
42	
43	新增：
44	- `packages/ai_agent/src/core/health_monitor.h/.c`
45	- `packages/ai_agent/src/infra/health_store.h/.c`
46	- `vendor/sifli/chips/sf32lb52/{include/,}sf32lb_bbram.h/.c`（封装 `HAL_*_backup`）
47	
48	计数器/心跳改造：
49	- `ws_server.c`：accept 心跳、clients、tx_ok/fail/timeout、rx_frames；`ws_server_get_stats()`。
50	- `mic_stream.c`：frames/bytes/read_errors/send_errors/last_frame_ms/restarts；`s_want_running` + mutex。
51	- `cron_service.c`：fires/errors/last_fire_ms；`cron_service_get_health()`（O(1)，不要再用 16 项栈拷贝）。
52	- `message_bus.c`：队列深度、drop 计数。
53	- `llm_router.c`：暴露 `fail_count/total_failures/avg_latency_ms/all_backoff`。
54	- `agent_loop.c`：idle pop 超时 beat；LLM/tool 调用前后设置 `HEALTH_AGENT_LLM/TOOL`。
55	- `agent_main.c`：outbound pop 改为 5 s 超时 beat；`network_watch_task` 每秒 beat 并在启动 agent/WS 后通知 health。
56	- `lvgl_ui_channel.c`：LVGL 事件循环 beat（仅 warning 级）。
57	- `agent_compat.h`：`_agent_task_args_t` 增加 `name`，trampoline 内 `pthread_setname_np()`。
58	- `agent_mem.h`：`largest_block` 改用 `mxordblk`。
59	
60	health 线程：16 KB 栈、优先级 65、5 s 周期；启动放在 `agent_main.c` 所有服务启动之后。boot 后 120 s 内只采集不判定。
61	
62	### Phase 1 — API / UI / Agent 工具
63	
64	- `api_handler.c`：扩展 `GET /api/health`，保留 legacy 四字段；`ok` 改为 `status==ok`；新增：
65	  - `status`（starting/ok/degraded/critical）、`stale`、`boot_count`、`auto_reset_count`、`reset_reason`、`safe_mode`、`needs_config`
66	  - 分组：`heap/tasks/net/ws/mic/cron/llm/bus/recovery`
67	  - `issues[]`、`last_anomaly`
68	  - 固定 1536 B `snprintf` 缓冲，不用 cJSON；HTTP 始终 200（避免主机 watchdog 误判）。
69	  - `POST /api/health/ack`：清 `auto_reset_count/safe_mode`。
70	  - `POST /api/health/fault`：仅 `CONFIG_AI_AGENT_HEALTH_TEST=y`。
71	- UI：
72	  - 状态栏增加 8×8 健康圆点（teal/amber/red），用 `lv_obj_create` + 圆形，避免字体依赖。
73	  - 状态页增加健康横幅 + 一行 top issue/趋势；原卡片整体下移。
74	  - `ui_status_sample()` 改为读 `health_monitor_get()`，删除重复的 mallinfo/nxsched_foreach/cron_list_jobs；时间同步保留在 UI 线程。
75	- Agent：
76	  - 新增 `src/tools/tool_device_health.c/.h`，注册 `get_health`，加入 `s_exposed_tools[]`。
77	  - `device-guardian` skill 优先 `get_health`，失败再回退 `run_shell free/ps/df/uptime`。
78	  - NSH `health` 仅作调试入口（生产 rcS 下 console 被 pppd 占用）。
79	
80	### Phase 2 — 规则、趋势与告警
81	
82	规则表（默认值，Kconfig 可调）：
83	
84	| 规则 | 条件 | 去抖 | 动作 |
85	|---|---|---|---|
86	| HEAP_LOW | free < max(512 KB, arena/16) → warning；< max(128 KB, arena/64) → critical | 2/1 次 | critical 且可复位类 |
87	| HEAP_FRAG | maxfree < 64 KB 且 free > 512 KB，或 maxfree/free < 10% | 3 次 | warning |
88	| HEAP_TREND | 5 min 斜率 < -256 KB/min → warning；< -1 MB/min → critical | 3 次 | critical 可复位 |
89	| TASK_GROWTH | count > baseline+8 → warning；> baseline+16 → critical | 3 次 | 报告，不单独复位 |
90	| TASK_STALL | 关键线程 last-seen 超时（见下表） | 2 次 | 按线程类别 |
91	| WS_TX_FAIL | 60 s 失败率 >20% 且 ≥5 次 → warning；>50% 且 ≥10 次 → critical | 2 次 | drop 问题 client |
92	| WS_ACCEPT_DEAD | accept 心跳 >10 s 或 listener fd <0 | 2 次 | listener 重启；2 次失败后 critical |
93	| MIC_STALL | expected && (!running 或 last_frame_age >3 s) | 1 次 | 重启 mic；10 s 无帧 → critical |
94	| MIC_ERR | 60 s 读错误 >3 或发送错误率 >20% | 2 次 | 重启 mic |
95	| MIC_OVERRUN | overrun/captured >1% | 3 次 | warning |
96	| NET_DOWN | 曾 up 且 down >30 s → warning；>180 s → critical | 2 次 | **只报告，不复位**（无网复位无意义） |
97	| NET_RTT | EWMA >2×baseline 且 >1500 ms，或连续超时 | 3 次 | warning，不单独复位 |
98	| CRON_STALL | 心跳 >60 s 或到期任务超过 2×周期未执行 | 2 次 | warning；>300 s 可复位类 |
99	| LLM_FAIL | 5 min 失败 ≥3 且失败率 >50%，或全 backend backoff | 3 次 | 只报告，绝不因云端故障复位 |
100	| LLM_SLOW | in_llm >300 s → warning；>960 s → critical | 1 次 | 只报告 |
101	| BUS_BACKLOG | outbound 深度 >12 持续 60 s | 3 次 | warning；伴随 outbound 心跳丢失才复位 |
102	| HOST_ABSENT | 无 HTTP/WS 120 s | — | 只影响复位门禁 |
103	
104	关键线程期望周期：
105	
106	| 线程 | 心跳 | warning/critical |
107	|---|---|---|
108	| outbound | 5 s | 30/60 s |
109	| agent_loop idle | 5 s | 30/60 s |
110	| agent_loop LLM | 240 s socket 上限 | 300/960 s，只报告 |
111	| agent_loop tool | 120 s | 120/300 s，可复位 |
112	| net_watch | 1 s | 10/30 s |
113	| cron | 10 s | 60/300 s |
114	| ws_accept | 0.5 s | 10/30 s |
115	| mic | 每帧 | 3/10 s |
116	| lvgl | 事件循环 | 5/30 s，仅 warning |
117	
118	状态机：`OK → DEGRADED → CRITICAL → RECOVERING → OK`；每个 issue 独立 streak，下降沿需连续 3 次健康清除（滞回）；EWMA alpha=0.3；斜率用 5 min 端点差；boot 后 120 s grace，heap/task 规则 60 s 后启用；LLM busy 豁免 idle 规则；mic 仅在 `want_running` 时算 expected。
119	
120	告警：
121	- WS 新增 `{"type":"health",...}`；状态迁移立即发，非 ok 每 60 s，ok 每 5 min；trylock，最多 500 ms。
122	- `voice_bridge.py` 增加 `health` 分支，打印不进入识别流程。
123	- `pipeline_watchdog.sh` 解析 `status/reboot_pending/handling/boot_count`；设备恢复期间抑制主机复位；恢复成功后 `POST /api/health/ack`。
124	- `voice_ready.sh` 增加 `--no-reset`；配置成功后读取 health 并 ack。
125	
126	### Phase 3 — 自治恢复与极少量持久化
127	
128	服务级恢复：
129	- **mic**：`mic_stream_restart()`；`s_want_running` 区分 host 期望与线程退出；mutex 串行化 start/stop；退避 10/30/90 s，最多 3 次。若 WS client 已不存在，只报 degraded，等待 host 重新 `mic_start`。
130	- **WS listener-only 重启**：
131	  - 新增 `s_accept_running`，accept 循环条件改为 `s_running && s_accept_running`。
132	  - accept 线程改 joinable；新增 `ws_server_listener_stop/start/restart()`，**不触碰 client 表、不修改 `s_running`**。
133	  - `shutdown(s_listen_fd, SHUT_RDWR)` + close + join（poll 500 ms，最多等 1 s），再重新 socket/bind/listen。
134	  - 不做完整 WS 重启（client 线程 detached、无 recv timeout，会泄漏/双关闭）。
135	- **WS client 失败**：`ws_server_drop_client(chat_id)`，只断开问题客户端。
136	- **agent_loop / 网络**：无安全重启接口；agent 卡死 → 软复位；网络 down → 等待 pppd/主机，不自动复位。
137	
138	软复位：
139	- 配置：`CONFIG_BOARDCTL_RESET=y`、`CONFIG_BOARDCTL_RESET_CAUSE=y`、`CONFIG_AI_AGENT_HEALTH_AUTORESET=y`。
140	- 触发条件（全部满足）：
141	  ```
142	  AUTORESET && status==CRITICAL && issue_is_reset_class
143	  && uptime>=120 && auto_reset_count<3 && !safe_mode
144	  && (net_ever_up || host_seen_within_120s)
145	  && (auto_reset_count==0 || uptime>=300)
146	  && !reboot_pending
147	  ```
148	- 复位前：置 `reboot_pending` → 更新快照 → best-effort 广播 health（≤500 ms）→ 写 BKP5/BKP6（回读校验）→ sleep 1–2 s → `boardctl(BOARDIOC_RESET,0)`。
149	- `safe_mode`：auto_reset_count 达到 3 后只告警；主机 `POST /api/health/ack` 清除。
150	- 复位后 `/data` 丢失：health 报 `needs_config`，UI 提示“配置待下发”；主机 `voice_ready.sh` 重新 `PUT /api/config` 并 ack。**只在网络曾 up/主机在场时复位**，避免无意义复位循环。
151	- 与主机协同：设备写 `reboot_pending/handling` 时主机 `bad=0` 并 hold 120 s；只有 HTTP 完全无响应且无这些标志时才走整板 RTS 复位。
152	
153	极少量持久化（RTC 备份，**BKP5/BKP6**）：
154	- Primary（BKP5）：magic 0xA5 + inverse 0x5A、boot_count(8b)、auto_reset_count(4b)、reset_reason(4b：unknown/power_on/pin/user/health_auto/watchdog/lowpower/host_reset)。
155	- Anomaly（BKP6）：issue_code(8b)、severity(2b)、reset_marker(1b)、valid(1b)、uptime 低 16 位。
156	- boot：`health_store_on_boot()` 读取校验；`boot_count++` 只执行一次（BSS 静态 flag）；`board_late_initialize()` 最前面调用一次 `HAL_PMU_CheckBootMode()` 捕获 WSR/boot mode，`board_reset_cause()` 只返回缓存（避免重复清 WSR）。若 anomaly reset_marker 置位，reason 覆盖为 `health_auto`。
157	- 写：状态迁移到 degraded/critical 时限 1 次/60 s；复位前强制写；写后回读，失败置 `persist_ok=false`。
158	- fallback：RTC 域掉电/索引冲突/写失败时，`persist_ok=false`；主机 `pipeline_watchdog.sh` 记录每次 health body、boot 时间和 reset_reason 作为权威历史。本阶段**不写 NOR**。

160	### Phase 4 — 故障注入与 HIL 验证
161	
162	测试端点（仅 `CONFIG_AI_AGENT_HEALTH_TEST=y`）：
163	```json
164	{"fault":"agent_stall","seconds":30}   // 一次性，验证降级后恢复
165	{"fault":"agent_stall","seconds":0}    // 永久，验证软复位
166	{"fault":"mic_read_fail","count":3}    // 验证 mic 重启
167	{"fault":"ws_send_fail","count":20}    // 验证 drop client
168	{"fault":"heap_hog","kb":6000}         // 验证 heap 规则
169	{"fault":"net_down","seconds":60}      // 验证无网不复位
170	{"fault":"fault_off"}
171	```
172	实现：agent_loop 顶部检查标志并 `sem_timedwait`；mic 读返回 `-ETIMEDOUT`；ws_send_frame_op 返回 -1/ETIMEDOUT；heap 按 64 KB 分配并保留；network_is_connected 测试模式返回 false。
173	
174	HIL 流程：
175	1. `rm -rf ~/openvela/cmake_out/sf32lb52_lchspi_ulp_agent`
176	2. 构建：`./build.sh vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52/sf32lb52_lchspi_ulp/configs/agent -e "-Wno-return-mismatch -Wno-implicit-function-declaration" --cmake -j8`
177	3. 检查 `.config` 中 health/reset 相关宏。
178	4. `python3 ~/tools/host/flash.py .../nuttx.bin`；`voice_ready.sh` 到 READY。
179	5. `curl /api/health | python3 -m json.tool`，确认 legacy + 新字段；屏幕状态页/圆点正常。
180	6. 基线：静置 30 min、音频 60 s、`ws_chat.py` 巡检、`load_test.py` 压测，status 保持 ok、无自动复位。
181	7. 逐项触发 fault，断言：mic 5–10 s 内 degraded→restart→ok；WS 失败只 drop client；agent stall 30 s 恢复；永久 stall 120 s 左右 critical→软复位，`boot_count+1`、reason=health_auto；heap hog 触发 critical；net_down 不复位。
182	8. 持久化：RTS 复位/断电重启，检查 boot_count/reason/persist_ok；主机日志兜底。
183	9. 安全模式：连续 4 次永久 stall，第 3 次后 `safe_mode=true` 不再复位；ack 后恢复。
184	10. 回归：`pipeline_watchdog.sh` 1 h 无假恢复；`soak.sh` 4 min 音频无额外 stall。

252	## 风险与限制
253	
254	1. **软复位后 `/data` 丢失**：LLM 配置/cron/记忆/技能消失。缓解：只在网络曾 up/主机在场时复位；health 报 `needs_config`；主机 `voice_ready.sh` 重配置并 ack。若要求完全无主机自治，后续需把极小配置落到 NVS（本阶段不做）。
255	2. **RTC 备份可能不保**：索引 5/6 未被 SDK 命名占用，但 SFBL/bootloader 可能使用；RTC 域掉电即丢。必须 HIL 验证；失败则 `persist_ok=false`，主机日志兜底。
256	3. **WS 完整重启不可行**：client 线程 detached、无 recv timeout、`ws_server_stop()` 不清 client fd；只做 listener-only 重启。
257	4. **agent_loop 无停止接口**：卡死只能软复位；不要尝试 `pthread_cancel`。
258	5. **内核竞态未修**：健康监测只能发现症状并恢复，不能消除 `sem_waitirq.c:137` 根因。
259	6. **误报/复位风暴**：通过 grace、去抖、滞回、LLM busy 豁免、复位门禁、auto_reset 预算、safe_mode、host ack 控制；阈值需 HIL 调。
260	7. **health 线程自身死亡**：本阶段无设备侧 dead-man，主机 `pipeline_watchdog.sh` 是最终兜底。
261	8. **观测开销**：mallinfo/nxsched_foreach 5 s 一次可接受；`STACK_COLORATION` 只每 60 s 扫关键线程；`SCHED_CPULOAD_SYSCLK` 开启后需用音频 soak 回归，若影响丢帧则关闭。
262	9. **生产 NSH 不可用**：健康入口必须走 HTTP/WS/Agent 工具，不能依赖 console。
263	
264	## 验收标准
265	
266	- `/api/health` 在正常/降级/严重/复位前都能返回结构化 JSON，`ok/status` 语义正确。
267	- 屏幕状态页能看到健康状态、top issue 和趋势。
268	- Agent 可通过 `get_health` 拿到一行健康摘要，`device-guardian` 优先使用它。
269	- 注入 mic 故障能自动恢复；注入 WS 发送失败只断开问题 client；注入 agent 永久 stall 能按门禁软复位，boot_count/reset_reason 正确（或 `persist_ok=false` 时主机日志可追溯）。
270	- 正常 180 s LLM 请求期间不会被误判为线程死亡。
271	- 主机 watchdog 在设备恢复期间不重复整板复位；恢复后 ack 生效。

21	/* Stream the on-board microphone to a WebSocket client.
22	 *
23	 * The device captures 8.46 kHz / 16-bit / mono PCM, compresses it to G.711
24	 * mu-law and pushes it as binary WebSocket frames; the far end is expected to
25	 * do the recognition. Keeping ASR off the device is deliberate -- the same
26	 * audio then feeds whatever recogniser the host has, including ones that
27	 * would never fit in the firmware, and the device stays a capture endpoint.
28	 */
29	
30	/* Largest chunk the stream will send in one frame, in samples. Kept under
31	 * the encoder's 65535 byte frame limit with room to spare.
32	 */
33	
34	#define MIC_STREAM_MAX_SAMPLES 8192
35	
36	/* Upper bound on one frame, in samples; the capture driver decides how much
37	 * of it to use. It must stay strictly below the DMA ring --
38	 * SF32LB_AUDIO_DMA_WORDS, currently 8192 -- because the reader tracks its
39	 * position modulo the ring, so an advance of exactly one ring reads back as
40	 * no advance at all and capture stalls with no error anywhere.
41	 *
42	 * The ceiling only bites when a backlog has built up -- the driver returns as
43	 * soon as it has a useful amount, not when it has filled the request -- and
44	 * that is exactly when frames come out largest, so it is the backlog case
45	 * that needs bounding.
46	 *
47	 * 1024 rather than the largest that fits: every writer on a client's socket
48	 * (this stream, agent replies, keepalive pongs) serialises on one mutex, and
49	 * a send is a blocked send for as long as a frame takes to shift over a
50	 * ~6 KB/s link -- about 170 ms here against ~700 ms at 4096. That bounds how
51	 * long one slow writer can hold the socket against the others.
52	 *
53	 * Measured caveat: shortening this did NOT stop the far end missing
54	 * keepalives under a heavy agent load. The dominant cause there turned out to
55	 * be a *different* WS client that stops reading, which parks the shared send
56	 * mutex inside send() and starves every other writer regardless of frame
57	 * size. Bounding the frame is still worth doing, it just is not the fix for
58	 * that.
59	 */
60	
61	#define MIC_STREAM_DEF_SAMPLES 1024

1	#!/bin/bash
2	# Keep the demo pipeline alive without anyone watching it.
3	#
4	# The device can stop answering for reasons that are not ours to fix -- a
5	# scheduler fault we caught once, a link that goes quiet -- and when it does,
6	# everything downstream looks fine: the bridge is running, the log has no
7	# errors, and the screen just stops changing. The only symptom is that the
8	# byte counter in the log stops moving.
9	#
10	# So that counter is what this watches. Recovery is the same full bring-up
11	# voice_ready.sh does, because a device that has stopped streaming usually
12	# needs the reset rather than a reconnect.
13	#
14	#   ./pipeline_watchdog.sh [interval_seconds] [strikes_before_recovery]
15	
16	INTERVAL=${1:-20}
17	STRIKES=${2:-3}
18	LOG="$HOME/voice_test.log"
19	HEALTH_URL="http://192.168.223.2:28789/api/health"
20	WD_LOG="$HOME/watchdog.log"
21	
22	say() { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date +%H:%M:%S)" "$*" | tee -a "$WD_LOG"; }
23	
24	last=""
25	bad=0
26	
27	say "watching $HEALTH_URL + $LOG every ${INTERVAL}s (recover after ${STRIKES} failed checks)"
28	
29	while true; do
30	  sleep "$INTERVAL"
31	
32	  # The bridge prints the running total with each heartbeat, so a value that
33	  # does not move means no audio has arrived. Missing heartbeat lines
34	  # entirely reads as the same thing.
35	  cur=$(grep -o '[0-9]* bytes total' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | grep -o '^[0-9]*')
36	  health=$(timeout 4 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$HEALTH_URL" 2>/dev/null || true)
37	
38	  if [ "$health" != "200" ]; then
39	    bad=$((bad + 1))
40	    say "health probe failed (HTTP ${health:-none}, $bad/$STRIKES)"
41	  elif [ -z "$cur" ]; then
42	    bad=$((bad + 1))
43	    say "no heartbeat yet ($bad/$STRIKES)"
44	  elif [ "$cur" = "$last" ]; then
45	    bad=$((bad + 1))
46	    say "stalled at $cur bytes ($bad/$STRIKES)"
47	  else
48	    [ "$bad" -ne 0 ] && say "recovered on its own at $cur bytes"
49	    bad=0
50	  fi
51	  last="$cur"
52	
53	  if [ "$bad" -ge "$STRIKES" ]; then
54	    say "device has stopped streaming; bringing the pipeline back up"
55	    bad=0
56	    last=""
57	
58	    # The bridge is the single entry point for serial, PPP and audio, and
59	    # voice_ready.sh does not start it. If it died, the full bring-up below
60	    # cannot succeed, so recover it first.
61	    if ! pgrep -f "[b]ridge.py" >/dev/null || [ ! -e "$HOME/ttyHS" ]; then
62	      say "serial bridge is down; restarting it"
63	      if [ -x "$HOME/bridge_restart.sh" ]; then
64	        bash "$HOME/bridge_restart.sh" >> "$WD_LOG" 2>&1 || \
65	          say "bridge restart failed"
66	      else
67	        say "bridge_restart.sh missing; cannot recover the bridge automatically"
68	      fi
69	    fi
70	
71	    start=$(wc -l < "$WD_LOG")
72	    bash "$HOME/voice_ready.sh" >> "$WD_LOG" 2>&1
73	    # Count only this attempt's failures: the log accumulates across runs, so
74	    # a running total climbs forever and hides whether recovery worked.
75	    this_run=$(tail -n "+$((start + 1))" "$WD_LOG" | grep -cE 'FAIL')
76	    if tail -n "+$((start + 1))" "$WD_LOG" | grep -q 'READY'; then
77	      say "recovery OK"
78	    else
79	      say "recovery FAILED ($this_run failed checks this attempt)"
80	    fi
81	  fi
82	done

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""PC-side voice bridge for the Huangshan Pi AI Agent.

Captures the device microphone over the agent's WebSocket channel, runs
offline speech recognition on the PC, turns the transcript into a device
command, and hands that command back to the agent.

    device MEMS mic
      -> AUDCODEC ADC capture (sf32lb_audcodec.c)
      -> binary WebSocket frames @16 kHz / 16-bit mono
      -> this script: energy VAD -> sherpa-onnx offline ASR
         (FireRedASR2-AED by default when downloaded, Paraformer fallback)
      -> transcript -> wake phrase -> understanding step -> command
      -> {"type":"message","content":...} back to the device
      -> agent executes (cron tasks, telemetry, screen, ...)

Two ways to address the device:

  * the PTT button on the screen -- press to talk, the whole window is kept
    and recognised in one piece;
  * the wake phrase "你好openvela" -- say it, then the command. Both in one
    breath works too. A command spoken without it is ignored, which is what
    keeps room noise from firing commands at the agent.

Usage:
    python3 voice_bridge.py [--host H] [--port P] [--seconds N]
                            [--thresh N] [--no-vad] [--save-wav DIR]
                            [--no-wake]

The device side must be running the agent with CONFIG_SF32LB52_AUDCODEC and
the mic streaming support compiled in.
"""

# The device compands to G.711 mu-law at 8462 Hz, one byte per sample. A 60 s
# soak at this rate sustained 8.40 KB/s with zero ping loss; a 17.4 kHz /
# 4-bit ADPCM trial showed the practical link ceiling is ~8.0-8.4 KB/s, so
# this is the widest rate that stays reliable. The real rate arrives in the
# stream's audio_format frame; this is only the fallback.
DEVICE_RATE = 8462

# The device sends large frames (throughput), but endpointing wants small
# ones. Decouple the two here: whatever arrives is sliced back into fixed
# 100 ms pieces before the segmenter sees it, so tuning the device's frame
# size for the link never changes the VAD's resolution.

# the worst stall a busy agent produces, or a slow turn will look like a
# dead link.
STALL_S = 20.0

# audio_format frame on stream start; this is the fallback.
MODEL_RATE = 16000

 * Returned Value:

#!/bin/bash
# Inject a health fault on the device, for HIL verification only.
#
#   ./health_fault.sh health                 # print the current snapshot
#   ./health_fault.sh agent_stall 30         # 30 s stall, then self-recover
#   ./health_fault.sh agent_stall 0          # permanent stall -> soft reset
#   ./health_fault.sh mic_read_fail 3        # make the next 3 reads fail
#   ./health_fault.sh ws_send_fail 20        # fail the next 20 sends
#   ./health_fault.sh heap_hog 6000          # hold 6000 KB (until fault_off)
#   ./health_fault.sh net_down 60            # pretend the link is down
#   ./health_fault.sh fault_off              # clear everything
#
# The device must be built with CONFIG_AI_AGENT_HEALTH_TEST.

set -u

DEV_IP=${DEV_IP:-192.168.223.2}
PORT=${PORT:-28789}
BASE="http://$DEV_IP:$PORT/api/health"

usage() {
  sed -n '2,16p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'
}

case "${1:-}" in
  health)
    curl -sS "$BASE" | python3 -m json.tool
    exit 0
    ;;
  agent_stall)
    body="{\"fault\":\"agent_stall\",\"seconds\":${2:-30}}"
    ;;
  mic_read_fail)
    body="{\"fault\":\"mic_read_fail\",\"count\":${2:-3}}"
    ;;
  ws_send_fail)
    body="{\"fault\":\"ws_send_fail\",\"count\":${2:-20}}"
    ;;
  heap_hog)
    body="{\"fault\":\"heap_hog\",\"kb\":${2:-6000}}"
    ;;
  net_down)
    body="{\"fault\":\"net_down\",\"seconds\":${2:-60}}"
    ;;
  fault_off)
    body='{"fault":"fault_off"}'
    ;;
  *)
    usage
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

echo "POST $BASE/fault $body"
curl -sS -X POST "$BASE/fault" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "$body"
echo
